_doc: M4 trend thresholds (rate-of-change per 10Hz tick). Rules, not learning: no training, no model file. Backend evaluates these on live ROC features every slow tick (0.2Hz).
rule: roc > +thr sustained = RISING, roc < -thr sustained = FALLING, else STABLE. Sustained = 5 consecutive slow ticks. Prognosis consumes RISING + time-to-limit.
